text:
Ravi (Growth): kick-off: Skyport marketplace + co-hosted webinar + joint benchmarks. main deliverable: inbound lead contract and a short post-webinar nurture flow. who picks up routing?
Tess (PMM): I'll take webinar deck + benchmark narrative. propose demo-first angle focusing on latency/COST per 1M tokens for embeddings workloads. target date May 18. Need UTM plan. :spiral_calendar:
Omar (PartnerOps): I’ll handle the marketplace listing and partner asset transfer. Skyport requires a 120x60 logo + 3 feature bullets and a 100-word partner blurb. can partner deliver by Apr 30?
Jules (Content): need assets by May 3 to publish pre-event blog and greenlight co-auth piece (guest quote + 300-500 word guest section). I'll draft landing + copy.
Nia (Sales Ops): inbound routing: prefer leads to hit our webhook -> SFDC with partner=skyport, lead_type=partner_event. also need an immediate Slack alert for "hot" leads (intent field). sample payload below: 
```json
{
  "webhook":"https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead-ingest",
  "payload":{
    "email":"{{email}}",
    "name":"{{full_name}}",
    "company":"{{company}}",
    "title":"{{job_title}}",
    "company_size":"{{company_size}}",
    "intent":"{{intent_level}}",
    "utm_source":"skyport",
    "utm_campaign":"skyport_may18_webinar",
    "partner":"skyport"
  }
}
```
Ravi (Growth): Omar confirm partner will provide company_size & intent if they do registration on our form.
Omar (PartnerOps): Partner prefers registrants to use our form; they can pass company_size and intent as fields.
Sam (Legal): flag: need partner logo license + written quote approval before publish. also confirm GDPR consent copy on landing. request logo permission by Apr 25.
Tess (PMM): benchmark plan: small internal run comparing response latency and cost for semantic search across shared vs dedicated serving. Jules, can you include a one-chart snapshot + one-sentence headline stat by May 7?
Jules (Content): yes — drafting blog + landing. will include CTA copy, privacy blurb for EU users, and a consent checkbox. sending draft to Sam by Apr 22.
Nia (Sales Ops): SDR routing rules: if intent>=medium -> assign to partner SDR queue. if intent==high -> create SFDC lead + post to #inbound-hot-leads with: "Hot Lead — <name> @ <company> — intent: high — <sfdc link>"
Ravi (Growth): next steps checklist: Omar confirm partner timeline by Apr 18; Sam reviews consent/logo by Apr 22; Jules deliver landing & blog draft Apr 22; Tess deliver benchmark data Apr 25; Nia to test webhook + Slack integration by May 6. call out blockers here. :eyes:
PartnerBot: Event created for 2026-05-18 17:00 UTC. Reminder set. :robot_face:
